parameters.name: DestVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the OTA update package. Only letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. The version number must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: FirmwareDesc
parameters.description: The description of the OTA update package. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character.

parameters.name: FirmwareName
parameters.description: The name of the OTA update package. The name must be unique within the Alibaba Cloud account and cannot be modified after creation. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and parentheses (()). The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, Japanese character, or digit. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length.

parameters.name: FirmwareSign
parameters.description:
The signature value of the OTA update package file. The value is calculated by applying the **SignMethod** to the content of over-the-air update package file.

><notice>This parameter can be specified only when the OTA update package contains a single file. If you do not specify this parameter, the MD5 value of over-the-air update package file in OSS is used as the signature value.
></notice>

parameters.name: FirmwareSize
parameters.description:
The size of the OTA update package file, in bytes.

><notice>This parameter can be specified only when the OTA update package contains a single file. If you do not specify this parameter, the size of the over-the-air update package file in OSS is used.
></notice>

parameters.name: FirmwareUrl
parameters.description:
The URL of the OTA update package file, which is the storage address of over-the-air update package file in Object Storage Service (OSS). You can call [GenerateOTAUploadURL](~~147310~~) to generate the URL of over-the-air update package file.

><notice>This parameter is required and can be specified only when the OTA update package contains a single file.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the OTA module. An OTA module represents a different upgradable module of devices under the same product.

> - If you do not specify this parameter, the default module is used, which represents the firmware of the entire device.
- You can call [CreateOTAModule](~~186066~~) to create a custom OTA module, and call [ListOTAModuleByProduct](~~186532~~) to query the OTA modules created under a product.

parameters.name: MultiFiles
parameters.description: The list of OTA update package files.

sub_parameters.name: FileMd5
sub_parameters.description:
The MD5 value of the OTA update package file.

>This parameter can be specified when the OTA update package contains multiple files. If you do not specify this parameter, the MD5 value of the over-the-air update package file in OSS is used.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the OTA update package file. The name must be 1 to 32 characters in length. You can add up to 20 file names, and the names of multiple over-the-air update package files must be unique.

><notice>This parameter is required when the OTA update package contains multiple files.
></notice>

sub_parameters.name: SignValue
sub_parameters.description:
The signature value of the OTA update package file. The value is calculated by applying the **SignMethod** to the content of over-the-air update package file.

>This parameter can be specified when the OTA update package contains multiple files. If you do not specify this parameter, the MD5 value of over-the-air update package file in OSS is used as the signature value.

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description:
The size of the OTA update package file, in bytes.

>This parameter can be specified when the OTA update package contains multiple files. If you do not specify this parameter, the size of the over-the-air update package file in OSS is used.

sub_parameters.name: Url
sub_parameters.description:
The URL of the OTA update package file, which is the storage address of the over-the-air update package file in Object Storage Service (OSS). You can invoke [GenerateOTAUploadURL](~~147310~~) to generate a file URL for each over-the-air update package file.

><notice>This parameter is required when the OTA update package contains multiple files.
></notice>

parameters.name: NeedToVerify
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the update package must be verified before a batch update task is created.

- **true** (default): Required.

- **false**: Not required.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the OTA update package belongs.

parameters.name: SignMethod
parameters.description:
The signature method of the OTA update package. Currently, only **MD5** (MD5 signature) is supported.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is **MD5**.

parameters.name: SrcVersion
parameters.description:
The version number of the OTA module to be updated, which is the current OTA module version of the device to be updated.

You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) to view the OTA module version of the device (**FirmwareVersion**).

> - If **Type** is set to **1** (delta update package), this parameter is required, and the value cannot be the same as the current update package version (**DestVersion**).
- If **Type** is set to **0** (full update package), this parameter is optional.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the OTA update package. Valid values:

- **0**: full update package. The over-the-air update package file contains the complete update package. The full update package is pushed to the device for the update.
- **1**: delta update package. The over-the-air update package file contains only the differences between the new version and the previous version. Only the differences are pushed to the device for the update.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is **0**.

parameters.name: Udi
parameters.description:
The custom information to be pushed to the device. The text content format is not restricted. The maximum length is 4,096 characters.

After the update package is added and an update task is created, IoT Platform pushes this custom information to the device along with the update notification.
